messages:
maria: Hey team — I'm trying to apply a promo code when upgrading our account but it fails with 'invalid or expired'. Account email: maria@acme.io. Code: SPRING50-ACME. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/example. Can someone check?

jess (Support): Hi Maria — sorry about that. Can you paste the exact code and your account id? Also did you ever sign up with an email alias (maria+something@...)? :thinking_face:

maria: Code is SPRING50-ACME. Account id is acct_9f2b. I might have used maria+dev@acme.io for a sandbox a while back but I don't recall redeeming any promo there.

jess (Support): Thanks — looping in billing to investigate. /cc @prateek (Billing)

prateek (Billing): Looking now. Quick check in the promo ledger: code SPRING50-ACME exists, uses_left=1, but it shows redeemed already by acct_3b7c (owner email maria+dev@acme.io). That looks like an alias of the same user. Do you confirm that's you? If yes we can either reassign or apply a manual credit.

maria: Yep that's me — created the sandbox months ago. I didn't realize the promo would be consumed by that alias. I'd prefer the credit on acct_9f2b if possible.

jess (Support): We can grant a manual credit to the account. @prateek can you run the internal grant and note the reason as alias redemption?

prateek (Billing): Executing grant now. Running: `rbctl promo-grant --code SPRING50-ACME --to acct_9f2b --note "manual: alias redemption"` — posting result shortly.

system-bot: Command output: SUCCESS — manual credit of $50 applied to acct_9f2b. Promo token remains redeemed on acct_3b7c (original redemption record preserved).

prateek (Billing): Done. Maria, you should now see a $50 manual credit on your billing dashboard (acct_9f2b). The promo string itself will still show as already used if you try to apply it again, but the credit covers the upgrade cost.

maria: I can confirm — I see +$50 on the billing page and the upgrade went through. Trying to reapply the code still returns 'already used' but the manual credit fixed it. Thanks so much :tada: :heart:

jess (Support): Great — marking this resolved on our side. Follow-up: we'll raise a UX note to make alias-based redemptions more visible in the promo admin UI so customers don't get surprised. /cc @olivia (CS) for tracking.

olivia (CS): Noted — filing ticket CS-1123 (promo alias confusion) and adding customer impact notes.

jess (Support): If anything else pops up, reply here and we'll reopen. :white_check_mark:
